units.source_text: 久米新任《东京日日新闻》学艺部长不久，头天晚上来这里观战，住了一夜。

en.t: Not long after Kume had newly become the arts editor of the Tokyo Nichinichi Shimbun, he came here the previous evening to watch the match and stayed overnight.

units.source_text: 近来，小说家担任报社学艺部长并不多见。

en.t: In recent times, it was not very common for a novelist to serve as the arts editor of a newspaper.

units.source_text: 围棋是在学艺部主管范围之内。

en.t: Go fell within the area overseen by the arts department.
